requirements.requirement: Tool rack that hangs on a wall from keyhole hangers
requirements.evidence: Linear 3-cell rack (piece:-1,0,0;full, piece:0,0,0;full, piece:1,0,0;full) with two keyhole hanger accessories on the rear faces: accessory:0#-1,0#3 and accessory:0#1,0#2 (slot 2 is rear outside face). JointBolt locks and caps applied.

requirements.requirement: With hooks for small hand tools
requirements.evidence: Three Hook plate accessories on front faces: accessory:0#-1,0#1, accessory:0#0,0#1, accessory:0#1,0#1 — each plate carries two hooks for hanging tools. Props (cable coil/tape) were refused PROP_NO_REST when hung low over bench but physical hooks are present.

finish.summary: Built 3-cell linear wall rack with two keyhole hangers on rear and three hook plates on front. Check_build is ok and meshClash clear.

lines.label: M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
